2609.24976.title: DexTacWAM: A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation
2609.24976.paper_summary: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision. Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics. We present DexTacWAM, a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling. Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline. Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 to 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert. After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining, while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts. The compressor retains 89.4% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26x faster training and 1.29x faster inference. Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.
2609.24976.paper_summary_zh: 靈巧的操作依賴於接觸動力學，而這些動力學通常僅能從視覺中部分觀察到。最近的世界行動模型（WAMs）將預測性視頻世界建模與動作生成結合起來，但仍然主要以視覺為中心，因此無法直接建模這些接觸動力學。我們提出了DexTacWAM，一種視覺觸覺WAM，獨立編碼每個指尖，通過指頭和姿勢感知的觸覺壓縮器聚合結果特徵，並將觸覺潛變量注入視頻擴散世界模型中，以進行聯合視覺觸覺世界建模。在22自由度的雙手平台上進行的六個接觸豐富的靈巧操作任務中，DexTacWAM在每個任務上都達到了最高分數，平均得分為70.6，而最強基線為38.0。消融實驗將增益歸因於將接觸演變建模為預測世界狀態的一部分，而不僅僅是觸覺條件：去除觸覺世界建模使四任務的平均分從74.7降至26.6，同時保持相同的觸覺特徵和動作專家。在使用凍結的預訓練視覺變分自編碼器進行四小時的觸覺編碼器適應後，我們的持續視覺到觸覺學習將預訓練視頻模型擴展到觸覺，使用大約每個任務100個演示，無需觸覺中期訓練，同時保持視覺預測質量在與僅視覺對應物的0.5 dB之內。壓縮器保留了89.4%的預融合接觸召回率，同時實現了2.26倍更快的訓練和1.29倍更快的推斷。綜合這些結果顯示，預訓練的視頻先驗可以以數據和計算效率高的方式擴展到分佈式多指接觸動力學。
